capture_audit_portability.observed_issue: audit_public.py keys manifest source rows by absolute source path, then looks them up using the current probe root. A relocated worktree therefore misses the lookup even when archived and live bytes match. capture_public.py and capture.py also hard-code /workspace/bytes-proof-tools paths for tool config/private Std inputs. The official audit writes an audit JSON beside evidence, so a baseline audit invocation mutates the repository.
capture_audit_portability.constructor_draft_observation: The untracked original-public-constructor-gate draft currently copies the same path-sensitive capture_public.py/audit_public.py pattern; this is a preliminary read-only observation and is excluded from baseline proof claims.
recommended_reusable_design: Anchor crate paths from the script location or an explicit --crate-root; accept external tool/Std roots through an explicit argument or environment variable, then archive those inputs under stable inputs/... member paths.

Store repository-relative source paths and archive_member mappings, plus the exact source commit; do not store absolute machine paths as join keys. For private Std, store its own archive SHA256SUMS and package metadata as evidence.
Have capture --positive check frozen source/configuration hashes, an explicit selected target list, every selected Coma/proof hash, and zero null leaves before creating a non-overwritable archive.

Make audit self-contained over the tarball and adjacent manifest; optionally accept --worktree-root for a path-independent live-source comparison. Emit JSON to stdout or an explicit --output so audit is read-only by default.
